data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement `compare-gate-vs-actual-tests.sh` to make the RED tests pass. The script reads the audit-log entry produced by 8845-1d10 (gate-required tests + match method per source file) and an 'actual exercise' input (phantom-detector output from 7c31-5862, or a coverage manifest if available), then emits a structured comparison artifact identifying false positives (required ∧ ¬exercising) and under-coverage (exercising ∧ ¬required).

**Why**: Produces the literal sc-3 artifact — gate-required tests vs tests that actually exercise changed code.

**Scope**:
- IN: Script implementation at plugins/dso/scripts/compare-gate-vs-actual-tests.sh; config knob for false-positive threshold; docs reference in HOOKS-REFERENCE.md or contracts/
- OUT: Surfacing the artifact into sprint-list-epics.sh or CI (deferred — can ride on the pattern from 7dc0-b784 if needed)

## Acceptance Criteria

- compare-gate-vs-actual-tests.sh exists under plugins/dso/scripts/ with executable bit set
- Script reads audit-log entries (format defined by 8845-1d10) and phantom-detector output (format defined by 7c31-5862)
- Script emits a JSON artifact with required_tests, actually_exercising_tests, false_positives, under_coverage, and per-source-file breakdown
- Configurable false-positive threshold via a config key documented in plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- All RED tests from the paired RED task now pass (GREEN state)
- Targeted test run via test-batched.sh confirms only the new tests turned GREEN; no other tests regressed
- Script is referenced from plugins/dso/docs/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md (or an appropriate docs file) so it is discoverable
data.title: Implement compare-gate-vs-actual-tests.sh sc-3 comparison artifact
